title: Two Weeks in Tanzania: A Complete Route
excerpt: Two weeks in Tanzania lets you see the best of the north, with time for an extra region and a relaxed beach stay.
body:

A gentle start with a [walk or canoe trip](/blog/canoe-safari-arusha/).

Two nights for elephants and a walking safari.

## Day 5: Lake Manyara or Karatu

A visit to [Mto wa Mbu](/blog/mto-wa-mbu-village/) or a coffee farm.

## Day 6–9: Serengeti

Two regions, for example central and north (July–October) or central and south (December–March).
